# Metadata stats_data_type_summary

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  data_type,
  COUNT(*) AS usage_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) AS tables_using
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE
  NOT table_schema IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog')
GROUP BY
  data_type
ORDER BY
  usage_count DESC
LIMIT 20
```
